concerns.text: FR-002 mandates preprocessing with Nilearn (>=0.10.0), but the original idea and the Constitution (Principle VI) explicitly require FSL/AFNI pipelines. This methodological shift diverges from the proposed approach and may affect reproducibility and validity.

FR-004 defines the skill proxy as either the binary task condition (Improvisation vs. Scripted) or years of training. The idea’s methodology sketch calls for expert blind ratings (or pre‑study assessments) of improvisation skill. Using only task labels or training years weakens construct validity and does not fulfill the intended measurement of ‘musical improvisation skill’.
